release.notes: 12 V battery protection on by default: evDash disconnects below 11.5 V or when the adapter cannot report its voltage (Settings, can be switched off). New: demo mode on a recorded Ioniq 6, charge and low-battery SoC alarms, pre-purchase health score, range at the recent pace, charging card OF MAX % and rated power, 12 V / DC-DC verdict, offline charger tiles. Fixes: E-GMP 12 V/DC-DC currents, Leaf 40 SoC, Volvo/Polestar DC charging, STLA Medium cells, charge report energy after a link gap.
